name: App icon
summary: An app's own icon: its glyph in white on the brand's blue, one family for every SyWare app.

name: Avatar
summary: A person, a team or a bot: a picture, or initials on a colour their name picks.

name: Badge
summary: A short status, coloured by its tone.

name: Button
summary: A button for actions, from the main one of a page to quiet ones in a toolbar.

name: Checkbox
summary: A box to tick, with its label beside it.

name: Chip
summary: A compact token: a filter to turn on and off, a tag to take away, or a label.

name: Divider
summary: A line between groups of content, across or up and down, with an optional label.

name: Icon
summary: A lucide icon by name, sized in pixels and coloured by its text.

name: Input
summary: A single-line text field that takes part in forms.

name: Kbd
summary: A keyboard shortcut, one keycap per key, written the way the platform does.

name: Link
summary: A link in text, a list or a footer, with safe external links.

name: Loading bar
summary: A thin line that says something is on its way: nothing for a moment, then growing, never at the end.

name: Progress
summary: A bar that shows how much of a task is done, or that work goes on.

name: Progress ring
summary: A ring that shows how much of a task is done, for small places.

name: Rating
summary: A row of stars to give a score, or to show one.

name: Select
summary: A choice among a list, on the browser's own select.

name: Skeleton
summary: A shimmering placeholder in the shape of content that is loading.

name: Slider
summary: A number picked by dragging along a track that fills in the accent colour.

name: Spinner
summary: A turning ring for work in progress.

name: Switch
summary: An on/off setting that applies at once.

name: Textarea
summary: A text field of several lines that can grow with its text and count its characters.

name: Accordion
summary: A list of sections that open under their headings, one at a time or several.

name: Accordion item
summary: A section that opens and closes under its heading: a disclosure, or one item of an accordion.

name: Account button
summary: The person signed in, in the frame of an app: avatar, name and role, opening their account.

name: Alert
summary: A message in the page, coloured by its tone: a tip, a success, a warning, a failure.

name: Avatar group
summary: A few people at a glance: overlapping avatars, and a count for the others.

name: Breadcrumb
summary: Where a page sits in a hierarchy: a trail of links that ends with the current page.

name: Calendar
summary: A month grid to pick a day, in any locale, from the pointer or the keyboard.

name: Card
summary: A flat surface for one subject: heading, content, media, actions and a footer.

name: Chip group
summary: A row of chips to choose from: one, as radios, or several, each turned on and off.

name: Code block
summary: Source code, coloured, with a button to copy it.

name: Combobox
summary: A text field with a list of options that narrows as people type.

name: Copy button
summary: Copies a text to the clipboard, and says so.

name: Date picker
summary: A date field that shows the date for people and opens a calendar to pick it.

name: Empty state
summary: What a list, a table or a page shows when it has nothing yet, and the way to fill it.

name: Facts
summary: The facts about one thing, label and value, the ones without a value left out.

name: Field
summary: A control with its label, a hint and an error message.

name: File drop
summary: A zone to drop files on or browse for them, with the chosen files listed under it.

name: Input list
summary: A field with several values, each in its own row, added and removed.

name: List item
summary: A row of a list: icon or avatar, heading, description, a note and trailing controls.

name: Load more
summary: The end of a long list: how much shows, and a button for the next page.

name: Load state
summary: What a list shows while its data comes, when there is none, and when it failed to come.

name: Menu
summary: A list of actions that opens from a button, driven by the pointer or entirely by the keyboard.

name: Number input
summary: A number field with − and + buttons, arrow keys and bounds.

name: Pagination
summary: Moves through pages of results, with the current page, its neighbours and the ends a click away.

name: Popover
summary: A floating panel that opens from a button: a small form, settings or details, closed by a click outside.

name: Radio group
summary: One choice among a few, all in view, as radios or as cards.

name: Search
summary: A search field that waits for a pause in the typing, with a keyboard shortcut.

name: Search button
summary: What opens the command palette: a search field to press, with its keys.

name: Segmented control
summary: A few exclusive choices in a row, with a thumb that slides to the chosen one.

name: Stat
summary: A key figure with its label, its change and a sparkline of recent values.

name: Steps
summary: The steps of a process and where people are: done, current, and still to come.

name: Tab panel
summary: One panel of a jl-tabs: its content, and the label, icon and badge of its tab.

name: Tabs
summary: Tabs over panels of content: one panel shows at a time, the others a click or an arrow key away.

name: Tag input
summary: A field that collects short texts as removable chips.

name: Timeline
summary: What happened, in order, along a vertical line with markers coloured by tone.

name: Toast
summary: A short notification that something happened, with an optional action, that can close by itself.

name: Tooltip
summary: A short hint in a dark bubble, shown when the pointer rests on its trigger or the keyboard reaches it.

name: Command palette
summary: A search box over every command of an app, opened by ⌘K or Ctrl+K, with fuzzy matching, and the app's own results for what was typed.

name: Confirm
summary: A yes-or-no question in a small modal, and confirmDialog() to ask it with await.

name: Dialog
summary: A modal window over the page, for a task or a decision that needs full attention.

name: Drawer
summary: A panel that slides over the page from an edge, for a task beside the page rather than in place of it.

name: Flow
summary: Nodes joined by edges, to move, connect and extend: a workflow editor.

name: Navbar
summary: The bar at the top of an app: brand, main links and actions, folding its links on a narrow width.

name: Page header
summary: The top of a page: breadcrumb, heading, description, actions and a row of badges.

name: Page outlet
summary: Where the pages show: the next one loads out of sight, under a line, and shows once it has its data.

name: Side nav
summary: The navigation down the side of an app, with nested items and a collapsed rail.

name: Tab bar
summary: The bar along the bottom of a phone: the main places of an app, one tap away.

name: Table
summary: Rows of records under column headings, with sorting, selection, rows that open on their details, formats and a sticky header.

name: Toaster
summary: The corner of the window where toasts stack, and toast() to show one from anywhere.

name: Tree
summary: Nested items that open and close, as files in folders, with the keyboard of a tree; loaded a page at a time for large ones.

name: App shell
summary: The frame of an app: top bar, sidebar, scrolling main area and side panel, with a drawer and a tab bar when narrow.

name: Auth layout
summary: The sign-in screen every SyWare app shares: the brand on a dark panel, the form beside it.

name: Page
summary: A page of an app: its header with a named back link, then its content at one of four widths.

name: Split view
summary: Two panes with a divider to drag between them, side by side or stacked.

name: Stack
summary: Its children one under the other, with one space between them: the layout of a form.
